# ParticleOverflow

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Particles` · enum

```csharp
public enum ParticleOverflow
```

What happens to a new particle when an effect already has its [`ParticleEffect.Capacity`](ParticleEffect.md#capacity) of particles.

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| <a name="dropnew"></a>`DropNew` | The new particle isn't added. |
| <a name="replaceoldest"></a>`ReplaceOldest` | The oldest particle is removed to make room, so a busy effect's particles are cut short. |
